note: Synthetic data for a portfolio demo. Every company is fictional and no field holds personal data; any resemblance to a real organisation is coincidental.

accounts.current_environment: Two colocated data centres running VMware, with nightly batch jobs for route planning.
stated_pain_points: Peak-season capacity has to be bought a year ahead
The data centre lease renews in 18 months
New tracking features take months to ship

accounts.current_environment: One primary data centre plus a disaster recovery site, with a large on-premises imaging archive.
stated_pain_points: Imaging storage grows faster than the budget
Disaster recovery tests take two days
Analytics queries slow down at month end

accounts.current_environment: A hosted private cloud running a monolithic e-commerce platform.
stated_pain_points: Holiday traffic forces year-round over-provisioning
Releases take weeks
Inventory data arrives hours late

accounts.current_environment: Colocated racks with a very large on-premises media archive.
stated_pain_points: The transcoding queue backs up at launch events
Archive storage cost is rising 30 percent a year
Hard to experiment with machine learning

accounts.current_environment: A mainframe core policy system plus distributed claims applications.
stated_pain_points: Mainframe skills are retiring
Claims turnaround is slower than competitors
Actuarial runs are limited by available capacity

accounts.current_environment: One server room in the county building and a small recovery site, running mostly packaged software on ageing hardware.
stated_pain_points: Server hardware goes out of vendor support next year
Records requests take days because the archive is on tape
There is no tested disaster recovery plan

accounts.current_environment: A central data centre plus departmental research clusters, with e-mail already moved to a software-as-a-service product.
stated_pain_points: Research data grows faster than the storage budget
Load peaks every enrolment week
Departments buy their own servers outside central IT

accounts.current_environment: Two data centres, with the core banking package on Unix servers and card processing in a separate PCI-scoped network.
stated_pain_points: Disaster recovery tests take a weekend and still miss recovery targets
Online banking slows down on payday
Regulators keep asking for evidence of tested recovery

accounts.current_environment: A small data centre with a large, mostly cold archive on inexpensive disk and tape, run by a team of four.
stated_pain_points: The archive grows by about a tenth every year
The tape library is nearing end of life
Staff time goes on hardware instead of access for the public
